architecture_decisions:
:
- The approved Work Specification and exact acceptance IDs remain authoritative.
- `ImplementationContentProposal`, server-canonicalized `ImplementationProposal`, `GeneratedSourcePatch`, `SourcePatch`, `CanonicalizingTextPatchEngine` and `SafeImplementationEngine` remain the canonical generation and mutation contracts.
- The protected runtime adds a sanitized server-owned preflight classifier that maps safe-engine exceptions to a fixed bounded reason-code vocabulary without returning exception text, source text, generated content, filesystem roots, provider payloads or secret material.
- The resilient live candidate-recovery path may validate each canonical patch independently against the authoritative workspace before whole-proposal admission.
- Independently safe, non-overlapping patches may be retained across existing bounded model generations within the same work unit.
- Retention is candidate evidence only: it grants no source mutation, lineage, BUILD, deployment, lifecycle or REVIEW authority.
- Subsequent repair generations receive only the exact acceptance contract, existing protected source context, retained target names, and sanitized rejection reason codes.
- Retained patch maps: The current-generation patches are retained as they are, and the final combined proposal, candidate artifact, or canonical workspace are not retained unless a later generation is returned.

validations: AC-01: validate protected requirement — Representative `UnsafeTargetError`, `StaleBaseError`, `PatchFormatError`, `PatchConflictError`, `PatchLimitError`, duplicate, hierarchy and aggregate implementation failures map to fixed reason codes. No test-visible classifier output contains arbitrary exception text or source content.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Given a generated proposal containing one safe canonical patch and one rejected patch, the resilient work-unit loop retains the safe patch as non-authoritative intent instead of discarding it when moving to the next admitted generation.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Rejected patches never enter the retained patch map, final combined proposal, candidate artifact or canonical workspace unless a later generation returns a separately safe replacement.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — After partial progress, the next admitted generation receives retained target names and sanitized rejection codes, does not receive retained/rejected content or unified diffs, and is instructed not to repeat retained targets.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — If a later generation returns a path already retained, that patch is rejected as `RETAINED_TARGET_REPEATED`; the original retained patch remains unchanged.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Ancestor/descendant target combinations across retained and current-generation patches are deterministically rejected with `TARGET_HIERARCHY_CONFLICT`; no source mutation occurs.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — A work unit is not marked complete merely because one or more patches pass individually. The combined retained plus new proposal must pass the unchanged full safe validator.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — When newly safe patches cause combined preflight failure, those current-generation additions are discarded, prior retained safe patches remain unchanged, and the next bounded generation receives a sanitized combined rejection reason.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Generations that produce no new safe patch or fail combined preflight consume the existing admitted-agent recovery sequence. Distinct-agent exhaustion plus the existing one final validator repair still terminates without increasing any retry or timeout budget.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — A converged proposal must still pass disposable protected BUILD, TEST and VERIFY and independent evaluation before selection. Incremental preflight evidence cannot substitute for these stages.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Only the existing final `SafeImplementationEngine.apply()` plus source-lineage gateway may mutate/accept canonical source. Partial retained patches never write canonical files or transition the Engineering Run.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Persisted candidate rejection/convergence evidence contains only fixed reason codes, bounded counts/identities and explicit false authority flags. Raw model output, source text, generated content, provider payloads and arbitrary exception messages are absent.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — Traversal, secrets, symlinks, unsupported extensions, stale source, collision, new nested parent handling, aggregate limits and target hierarchy protections remain unchanged and pass existing protected tests.

AC-14: validate protected requirement — Luna/Terra/Sol roster, 60-second hosted timeout, distinct-agent recovery count, final validator-repair count, request-level autonomy budget and zero hidden provider retries remain unchanged.

AC-15: validate protected requirement — Focused P2-V0.23.27 tests, full API regression, client checks, protected promotion evaluation, Bounded Autonomy Pilot, Workstream Spec Validation and required DSPy compile/verify pass on the exact reviewed head.

AC-16: validate protected requirement — After merge, the exact application source reaches READY on the production API, canonical `/health` and `/ready` return HTTP 200 with database/providers ready, and runtime warning/error/fatal verification is clean.

AC-17: validate protected requirement — A user-authenticated retry of Engineering Run `3a1ba66a-5649-42b6-81ee-91684fe06bbc` or equivalent exact work either enters BUILD after incremental proposal convergence or exposes a later bounded blocker. A repeated generic whole-proposal safe-validator exhaustion without retained convergence evidence fails this acceptance criterion.
